files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: In riders.csv, compute each rider's age in 2025 as 2025 minus birth_year and put riders into age bands under 25, 25-39, 40-59 and 60+; leave out riders with an empty birth_year. `result` should be a table indexed by those band labels in that order with columns riders (count) and mean_balance (average of non-empty credit_balance, 2 decimals).
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; riders with a birth_year only; age = 2025 - birth_year; bands under 25, 25-39, 40-59, 60+; per band: riders = count, mean_balance = mean of non-empty credit_balance (2 decimals). Index: the four band labels in that order.
